newsitem.title: USA: Beacon files shelf for $750 mln in common.
newsitem.headline: Beacon files shelf for $750 mln in common.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp said Wedensday it filed a shelf offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $750 million in common stock.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of indebtedness, investment in new properties and new developments and maintenance of currently owned properties, the company disclosed in the filing.
The company has the authority to issue 100 million shares of common stock. As of December 2, the Beacon had outstanding 46,959,055 common shares.

The Boston, Mass.,-based company is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust which owns a portfolio of Class A office properties and other commercial properties in major metropolitian areas.
